rules.rule: Edits only in-source comments; never write Example or README
must: never write an `Example\*` function or a package `README` overview

rules.rule: A comment that passes the checklist is left alone
must: a comment changes only when it fails the checklist
A comment that passes is left alone, however short

rules.rule: Never write a fact the code does not establish; flag instead
must: Never write a fact you cannot confirm from the code; flag it in the report
A type with no synchronization is not thereby documented

rules.rule: Never edit directives, generated files, or unconfirmable comments
must: magic directive comments
generated files marked `DO NOT EDIT`
a comment whose intent the code cannot confirm

rules.rule: //nolint is never deleted; unremarkable method keeps one-line implements
must: A `//nolint` directive on the method is never deleted: keep it verbatim
`// implements \[Iface\]\.`

rules.rule: Unremarkable interface-method godoc removed; never add
must: Never add godoc to an unremarkable one

rules.rule: Package comment in the package-named file; never create doc.go
must: never create a `doc\.go` for it

rules.rule: File/package/module plan then wait for approval
must: Wait for approval, then run the per-item loop and Verify
Run straight \(no plan gate\), then report

rules.rule: gofmt -l, go build per edited package, line limit
must: Run `gofmt -l` on every edited file
Run `go build \./<pkg>` on every edited package

rules.rule: Parent re-reads workers' edits against the checklist and reverts unsupported
must: Merging is not accepting
Revert what the code does not carry

rules.rule: Report shape and Verify result line
must: `file:Symbol — <checklist item #>: <what changed>`
A gate whose outcome never reaches the reply
